title: PLAT Module Manifest v1
description: Host-independent metadata for a packaged PLAT web module. Cross-field and archive rules are enforced by the package validator.

schemaVersion.description: Module manifest format version. Independent of module and Platform API versions.

id.description: Stable reverse-domain identifier. Must not change between releases of the same module.

version.description: Semantic Versioning 2.0.0. Build metadata does not affect precedence.

entry.description: Case-sensitive POSIX-relative path to the module entry HTML file. Must resolve to a regular file in the archive.

minVersion.description: Minimum compatible stable Platform API version. Host and minimum must have the same major version.

maxVersionExclusive.description: Optional exclusive upper bound. Must be greater than minVersion and use the same major version.

required.description: Capabilities that must be supported before the module can be activated.

optional.description: Capabilities used only when the Host advertises them.
